forbidden.message: ORM import (Prisma/TypeORM/Sequelize/MikroORM/Drizzle) — the standard uses hand-written SQL with pg or the Kysely query builder unless the project profile declares an ORM
ORM dependency added to package.json — not allowed unless the project profile declares it (and new dependencies need the user's confirmation)
process.env read inside a layer — env is parsed once by parseConfig() (src/core/config.ts) called from src/main.ts; inject the typed AppConfig instead
throw new Error() in application/core — throw a domain error from src/core/errors.ts (it carries its statusCode) so the error handler maps it
raw object sent with reply.send({...}) — return ApiResponse.ok/created/page(...) from src/api/response.ts (the standard envelope)
database pool created outside src/infrastructure — pools are created once by infrastructure/db.ts and wired in api/container.ts
Authorization header read in a route/service — the current user comes only from getCurrentUser(request) (src/api/auth)
SQL built by string concatenation in .query() — use $1..$n parameters (pg) or Kysely bindings
Kysely sql.raw()/sql.lit() bypass parameter binding — interpolate values in the sql`` tag (bound) and use sql.ref()/sql.id() with a whitelist for identifiers

recommendedSkills.why: Written by Fastify's lead maintainer: plugin encapsulation, hooks lifecycle, decorators, serialization and Pino details that complement this standard.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Ignore JSON Schema/TypeBox as the validation layer (this standard uses Zod via fastify-type-provider-zod) and running TypeScript directly with Node type stripping (this standard builds with tsc and runs dist/ in production; tsx only for dev).

recommendedSkills.why: Generics, conditional and mapped types for typed repositories, envelopes and DTO helpers without escaping to any.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: None material; never use its techniques to bypass strict mode (no any, no as unknown as, no non-null assertions to silence noUncheckedIndexedAccess).

recommendedSkills.why: General Node.js backend patterns (graceful shutdown, middleware ordering, caching, rate limiting) as background reading.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Ignore its Express-first examples, Winston logging, ad-hoc response shapes and folder layout: this standard mandates Fastify, pino, the ApiResponse envelope and the 4-layer src/ layout. Ignore any ORM usage.
